result.topic_en: Calculations on the Riemann zeta function via the theta-type function psi(x) = sum e^{-n^2 pi x}: its functional equation, splitting the Mellin integral at i, and a saddle-point (steepest descent) evaluation of the resulting integral; this is not about the fluid ellipsoid.
